title: Behavior artifact comparison
responsibility: Reads and verifies behavior artifacts, then compares recorded content while excluding explicitly declared run metadata.

inputs.name: explorerReading.behavior
inputs.description: Initial behavior comparison with capture references and uncertainty state.

inputs.name: explorerReading.mediaBase
inputs.description: Media address prefix used to read artifacts.

inputs.name: explorerReading.fetcher
inputs.description: Optional artifact byte loader, forwarded to the verified artifact reader.

outputs.name: artifactRun
outputs.description: Run metadata declaration: harnessRun, version 1, and the recognized startedAt, finishedAt, at, durationMs and pid keys.

outputs.name: artifactDifferences
outputs.description: Paths where values differ, comparing arrays by index and objects by sorted key union. Properly typed metadata is excluded only inside a supported run declaration; undeclared times and process IDs remain behavior. Trace-entry declarations are considered when the root has a supported declaration.

outputs.name: explorerReading
outputs.description: Resolves to rows carrying verified reads and content differences. Different-byte rows become changed or unchanged from their content; unverified reads become unknown. Existing not-compared or explained unknown summaries are retained. Reads within one invocation are cached by SHA-256.
